observations: Photo 0 shows a stainless steel gas cooker with four burners and four control knobs on the front panel.
The cooktop has black metal grates over the burners.
The surface appears clean and shiny, with no visible damage in the photos.
Photo 1 and Photo 2 show the same unit wrapped in clear plastic, with a handwritten 'OIS' on the plastic.
The plastic wrap is crinkled and shows signs of handling, but no visible damage to the cooktop is apparent.
No brand or model name is visible on the cooktop or any part of the unit in any photo.
The seller's text mentions 'Tokunbo' (imported second-hand) and 'neatly used', but no proof of usage or condition is visible.

claims.evidence: The cooktop appears clean and shiny, but no proof of usage or condition is visible. The 'Tokunbo' claim cannot be verified from photos alone.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The cooktop may have hidden damage or wear not visible under the plastic wrap.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the cooktop surface without plastic wrap, showing all burners and control knobs.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged or worn

risks.risk: The gas burners or control knobs may be non-functional or damaged.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the burners lit and the knobs operating.

risks.risk: The unit may be a counterfeit or non-genuine product.
risks.proof: A photo of the brand name or model number on the cooktop or control panel.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the brand name or model number on the cooktop or control panel.
Photo of the cooktop without plastic wrap, showing all burners and control knobs.
Video or photo showing the burners lit and the knobs operating.
Photo of the underside or back of the unit to check for damage or wear.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
